fusions.name: Refined Dosage
fusions.desc: Spits venom that deals 4 poison damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 30% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Once, Correctly
fusions.desc: A single practised bite that deals 32 damage and is always a critical hit. It leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Return to the Coil
fusions.desc: You recoil 2 tiles from where you stood, and the cooldown clears on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting.

fusions.name: Economy of Motion
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 8% sooner, and your dodge chance rises by 4%.
